EAST CONCESSION • SOUTH SINAI

Ras Budran Field

Located 10 km north of Abu Rudeis City. Operates three major offshore production platforms linked to integrated onshore separation, desalting units, crude storage farm, and offshore tanker loading terminal.

WEST CONCESSION • RED SEA

Zeit Bay Field & REB

Discovered in 1981 via exploration well QQ-89-1, extending 4.5 km by 2.5 km with land extension at Ras El-Behar. Houses SUCO central LPG & Natural Gas Plant sweetening associated gas for national networks.

LPG Plant Details ↗
SHARED FACILITY HUB

PetroZenima & Sister Hub

According to EGPC policy for optimal facility utilization, SUCO provides South Abu Zenima Petroleum Company (PetroZenima) dedicated crude storage, fiscal metering, and marine tanker loading export berths.

// WHY CHOOSE US //

Why EGPC & Global Partners Rely on SUCO for Production Rigor

Offshore Structural Integrity

Three permanent offshore fixed jackets engineered for Gulf of Suez hydrodynamics, equipped with gas lift compression, multiphase separation, and fail-safe automated emergency shutdown valves.

Central LPG Recovery & Gas Train

State-of-the-art gas processing plant in Zeit Bay converting wet associated gas into export-grade commercial LPG (propane/butane), eliminating unnecessary flaring and providing clean energy.

24/7 Marine Loading & Storage Capacity

Large-capacity onshore crude tank farm and single-point mooring tanker export system handling simultaneous SUCO production and third-party volumes with total fiscal precision.

// FAQ //

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

1 What are SUCO’s primary operating concessions in Egypt?
+
SUCO operates two primary oil and gas concessions in the Gulf of Suez: Ras Budran field (GOS East Concession, South Sinai) comprising three offshore platforms and an onshore terminal, and Zeit Bay field (GOS West Concession, Red Sea Governorate) with its land extension at Ras El-Behar.
2 How does SUCO support third-party and sister companies?
+
Under EGPC's facility-sharing policy, South Abu Zenima Petroleum Company (PetroZenima) transports crude oil to Ras Budran for processing, storage, and marine tanker loading. Additionally, SUCO's Zeit Bay gas plant processes and sweetens crude and wet gas from adjacent operators.
3 What HSEQ standards and environmental protocols does SUCO maintain?
+
SUCO is triple-certified for ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety). We enforce strict zero-discharge policies in the sensitive marine ecosystem of the Gulf of Suez and maintain an uncompromised Stop Work Authority policy.
4 Where is SUCO headquartered and how can vendors contact operations?
+
Our central headquarters is located at 21 Ahmed Orabi Street, Mohandessin, Giza, Egypt (P.O. Box 2622 Cairo). Vendor registrations, partner inquiries, and technical proposals can be directed to Tel: +202 3346 0524 / 0525 or email info@suco-eg.com.
